t031.sum: The Material Sons and Daughters are an order of sex-endowed Sons produced by the Creator Son for each local system; sent to the evolutionary worlds as Adam and Eve, they are charged with the biologic uplift of the races. Being material, they are visible to mortals and form the last link between the invisible Planetary Prince and human beings. The Adam and Eve of Urantia defaulted in their mission, yet their contribution greatly improved mankind.
t031.s1.i1: The Material Sons and Daughters are the offspring of the Creator Son; the Universe Mother Spirit takes no part in their production.
t031.s1.i2: For each system the Creator Son makes only the original pair, fashioned to the life pattern of that system, and all the rest are their descendants.
t031.s1.i3: They stand eight to ten feet tall and shine with a violet radiance; Adam and Eve are equal yet complementary and usually work as a pair.
t031.s1.i4: With a dual constitution that takes in both material food and cosmic energy, they are cut off from their life source if they rebel and in the end meet material death.
t031.s2.h: Life on Jerusem, the System Capital
t031.s2.i1: Each family of Material Sons and Daughters lives in the Adamic domain of one thousand centers on Jerusem, and their numbers increase by natural reproduction.
t031.s2.i2: The Adamites of Jerusem experiment with self-government through elections and representative government, and they handle most of the routine affairs of the capital sphere.
t031.s2.i3: The Melchizedeks maintain a faculty at each system headquarters for the education and spiritual training of young Material Sons and Daughters.
t031.s2.i4: While living on the system capital, Material Sons have no Thought Adjusters, but through service they gain capacity for Adjuster indwelling and the ascending career.
t031.s3.h: The Mission of a Planetary Adam
t031.s3.i1: When an evolutionary world reaches the peak of its physical evolution, a volunteer pair is chosen, dematerialized, and carried to that world by seraphim.
t031.s3.i2: On arrival they are rematerialized under the direction of the Life Carriers, and they remain in the unconsciousness of seraphic sleep throughout the process.
t031.s3.i4: Adam and Eve do not mate directly with the evolutionary races; their children voluntarily unite with superior men and women brought to the garden.
t031.s3.i5: With the added strain of the violet race, more progress is made in one hundred thousand years than in the previous million.
t031.s3.i6: The garden schools teach practical arts, economics, and civil government, and with the schools of the Planetary Prince they set the pace of civilization.
t031.s4.h: The Link Between God and Man
t031.s4.i1: Unlike the other planetary Sons, Material Sons are visible to mortals, understandable to them, and can actually associate with them.
t031.s4.i3: They can see the invisible Planetary Prince and his staff, and so they can interpret him to mortals.
t031.s4.i4: On the ascending path mortals come to recognize seven fathers, the second of whom is the Planetary Adam, the father of the realm.
t031.s5.h: The Adam and Eve of Urantia
t031.s5.i1: The Adam and Eve who came to Urantia were number 14,311 of the senior corps on Jerusem and had been heads of the laboratory dealing with the modification of life forms.
t031.s5.i2: They were overcome by the subtle counterplans of Caligastia and violated their covenant, but they did not join the Lucifer rebellion.
t031.s5.i4: Though the divine plan miscarried, the Adamic bestowal left the peoples of Urantia biologically far better than before.
t031.s5.i5: Adam and Eve awoke again on the mansion worlds in a special resurrection and returned to Jerusem as ascending citizens.
t031.s6.i2: An Adam and Eve who succeed in their mission may, once the world is settled in light and life, retire from administration and register as perfected Material Sons.
t031.s6.i3: Material Sons whose planetary assignment is long delayed may also be released from citizenship status and advance toward Paradise with the ascending pilgrims.
t031.s6.i4: Material Sons are rare in the finaliter companies but are always chosen as leaders, and an Edenic pair sometimes works together as one personality.
t032.sum: The Corps of the Finality is the presently known destination of the ascending mortals of time, who are mustered into it after finding God and attaining Paradise. Centered on glorified mortals, it also includes Havona natives, Gravity Messengers, adopted seraphim, Material Sons, and midway creatures, and its members now serve on worlds settled in light and life. Their ultimate destiny has not been revealed, but it is conjectured to concern the future universes of outer space.
t032.s1.i1: The primary Corps of the Finality consists of Havona natives, Gravity Messengers, glorified mortals, adopted seraphim, and glorified Material Sons and midway creatures.
t032.s1.i2: The corps is organized in companies of one thousand, of which mortals and seraphim make up 990, leaving only ten places for the other beings.
t032.s1.i3: All are received as equals, yet that equality does not erase individuality or personal identity.
t032.s1.i4: Gravity Messengers are personalized Adjusters who transcend time and space, and they share a deep affection with mortals who have fused with Adjusters.
t032.s1.i6: Evangels of light are attached temporarily without taking the oath, and the one vacancy beyond the 999 permanent members remains a mystery.
t032.s2.i1: Of all the creatures of the grand universe, only those fused with the Father are mustered into the mortal Corps of the Finality and take the finaliter oath.
t032.s2.i2: Spirit-fused mortals usually remain in local universe service and do not share the destiny of the Paradise Corps of the Finality.
t032.s2.i3: Many guardian seraphim ascend with their mortal wards, take the same finaliter oath, and are mustered into the corps.
t032.s2.i4: Children who die early, deprived of the experience of mortal life, become Paradise citizens but do not enter the Corps of the Finality.
t032.s3.i1: Mortals ascend through the stages of spirit one by one and become spirits of the sixth stage when they take the oath of the Corps of the Finality.
t032.s3.i2: The seventh jubilee celebrates entrance into the mortal Corps of the Finality and the beginning of eternal service.
t032.s3.i3: In the finaliter receiving circle, the chief of the Transcendentalers administers the eternity oath of the Trinity.
t032.s4.i1: Finaliters are not assigned to their native superuniverse until they have served in the other six, and so they gain a sevenfold concept of the Supreme Being.
t032.s4.i3: The finaliters are a self-governing body that chooses its own leaders, and their oath of allegiance is given to the Paradise Trinity alone.
t032.s4.i4: The first transition world of Satania is the headquarters of more than one hundred thousand finaliter companies, and finaliters remain invisible until true spirit vision is attained.
t032.s4.i5: The mortal Corps of the Finality serves in various roles on worlds settled in light and life, but it seems to have no settled duties as yet.
t032.s5.i1: Finaliters have reached the present limits of creature perfection, but not yet the ultimate spirit status or the finality of creature service.
t032.s5.i3: In the finaliter circle on Jerusem stands a sealed and empty temple inscribed "Not yet dedicated to the seventh stage of spirit."
t032.s5.i4: Having found the Father, the finaliters may one day have to begin a new search for the superfinite Father.
t032.s6.i1: The seven corps of finality are supervised by the senior Master Architect, and Grandfanda is head of the council of supreme destiny.
t032.s6.i2: It is conjectured that the finaliters will compensate for the experiential deficiency of the outer universes, which cannot share in the evolution of the Supreme Being.
t032.s6.i4: Even if there were no unrevealed future destiny, the present assignments of the finaliters would fully justify the ascension plan.
t033.sum: The Thought Adjuster is a fragment of God that comes directly from the Universal Father and indwells the human mind. It is not a created being but divinity itself; it leads man from within to do the Father's will and seeks to become one with the evolving soul and go forward with it in the eternal career. At the center of the personal religion presented in The Urantia Book stands this indwelling spirit of the Father.
t033.s1.h: A Divine Fragment from the Father
t033.s1.i1: Though he dwells on Paradise, the Father is actually present in the human mind as the Mystery Monitor.
t033.s1.i3: Adjusters are limited in scope yet absolute in essence, and so they are called the "qualified absolute fragments" of the Father.
t033.s1.i4: The Adjuster is not a personality, yet it is a true reality of the purest order in the universe, a divine presence.
t033.s2.i1: The Adjuster is assigned after the child makes its first moral choice, and on Urantia it arrives, on the average, just before the sixth birthday.
t033.s2.i2: The preparation of the seven adjutant mind-spirits and the circuitizing of the Holy Spirit must come first before an Adjuster can enter the mind.
t033.s2.i3: That a perfect Adjuster should volunteer to dwell in a mortal of animal origin is a marvel of divine condescension.
t033.s3.i1: The basic mission of the Adjuster is to represent the Universal Father to the mortal creature, and indeed to be that Father.
t033.s3.i2: The Adjuster comes with a plan for the ideal life, but man is free to accept or reject that plan.
t033.s3.i3: It undertakes the difficult work of an interpreter, receiving counsel from spiritual intelligences and conveying it to the material mind.
t033.s3.i5: Unless the mind's capacity is wholly destroyed, the Adjuster stays with a person through every calamity and illness.
t033.s4.h: A Life of Co-operation with the Adjuster
t033.s4.i2: Mental poisons such as fear, anger, envy, and suspicion greatly retard the Adjuster's work, as bodily poisons do.
t033.s4.i3: Confusion, discouragement, or ignorance alone does not prevent survival; only conscious resistance to the Adjuster's leading does.
t033.s4.i4: When clouds gather, faith should accept the fact of the Adjuster's presence and look to the light beyond.
t033.s5.i1: The Adjuster is the Father's love incarnate in the human soul, the essence of the finaliter personality foretasted in time.
t033.s5.i2: Mastering the seven psychic circles is not fusion itself but the preparatory stage leading to fusion.
t033.s5.i4: The eternal union of the Adjuster with a perfected creature brings into being a unique creature that no other universe technique can produce.
t034.sum: Adjuster fusion is the event in which the evolving immortal soul becomes eternally one with the indwelling Thought Adjuster. It usually takes place on the mansion worlds after death, but rarely it is achieved by translation during the life in the flesh. Fusion announces to the universe the mortal's final choice to do the Father's will; by it the ascender's eternal career is assured, and the way opens to the Paradise Corps of the Finality.
t034.s1.i2: Since the Adjuster is an immortal spirit, union with it confers eternal life on the soul of the fused mortal.
t034.s1.i3: In fusion the Adjuster and the soul share all of each other's experiences and values and actually become one being.
t034.s1.i4: The fused being is one personality, and no universe intelligence can distinguish the human and the Adjuster separately.
t034.s1.i5: The fused Adjuster keeps its existential divine nature yet is transformed to the level of finite experience and inseparably linked with the ascending personality.
t034.s2.i1: Fusion usually occurs during the sojourn in the local system, and sometimes it is delayed until the ascender reaches the constellation or the local universe capital.
t034.s2.i2: Fusion that is actually effective is often not achieved until the sojourn on the fifth or sixth mansion world.
t034.s2.i3: When the seven cosmic circles are attained and the final choice of the will is added, fusion may occur during the life in the flesh, and the body is instantly consumed.
t034.s2.i4: In the case of most Urantians, the Adjuster must wait patiently for the deliverance of death.
t034.s2.i6: On worlds settled in light and life, fusion translations steadily increase, and by the fourth stage more than half of all mortals are translated from among the living.
t034.s3.i2: Until fusion an ascender may at any time forsake the Father's will, but fusion announces that he has chosen the Father's will without reservation.
t034.s3.i3: The Adjuster of one who has made the supreme decision foresees the time of fusion and regards the union as an already existing fact.
t034.s3.i4: When Adjuster fusion proclaims the final choice to the universe, the eternal destiny of the human being is assured.
t034.s4.i2: The new being is presented under a new name, spends forty days in spiritual retirement, and chooses a route to Havona.
t034.s4.i3: On settled worlds the candidate for fusion departs in a flash of life before family and friends gathered in the temple.
t034.s4.i5: Those fused during the life in the flesh do not pass through death but go to the higher morontia spheres by direct Adjuster transit.
t034.s5.h: When Fusion Does Not Take Place
t034.s5.i1: Mortals are divided into three groups according to their relation to the Adjuster: temporary indwelling, nonfusion, and fusion-potential types.
t034.s5.i2: Mortals of primitive ages may survive through the ministry of Adjusters, yet they do not become eternally united with them.
t034.s5.i3: Mortals of the nonfusion type are also indwelt by Adjusters throughout life, but if they survive, their souls fuse with spirit.
t034.s5.i4: The few whose survival is recognized but who never become one with their Adjusters go, after the verdict of the courts of inquiry, on the path of fusion with the Son.
t034.s6.i2: Fusion confers on the personality actualities that were only potential: fixation of divinity qualities, past-eternity experience and memory, and immortality.
t034.s6.i3: In matters of personality the human leads in the fused ascender, whose headquarters is Ascendington rather than Divinington.
t034.s6.i4: The number of a fused Adjuster is stricken from the superuniverse records, and its destiny becomes the same as that of the ascending mortal: the Corps of the Finality.
t034.s6.i5: Through fusion the Universal Father fulfills his promise to give himself to his material creatures.
t034.s6.i6: Adjuster-fused mortals are the only human order that passes through the Havona circuits and finds God on Paradise.
t035.sum: The soul is a morontia reality newly arising from the relationship between the material mind and the indwelling Thought Adjuster, the child born of human effort and the divine spirit together. During the life in the flesh it grows like an embryo; it then survives death and becomes the new vehicle of personality on the mansion worlds. The growth of the soul depends on moral choices and the decision to seek God, and personality identity survives in the survival of the soul.
t035.s1.h: How the Soul Comes into Being
t035.s1.i1: When a mortal chooses to do the Father's will, the indwelling spirit becomes the father of a new reality and the material mind becomes its mother.
t035.s1.i2: Three factors operate in making the soul: the human mind, the indwelling divine spirit, and the relationship between the two.
t035.s1.i4: The divine spirit arrives with the first moral activity of the human mind, and at that very moment the soul is born.
t035.s1.i5: The morontia life of an ascending mortal actually begins at the moment the soul is conceived, when the Adjuster comes to indwell.
t035.s2.i1: The midway creatures called this soul the "midmind," meaning that it lies between the material mind and the cosmic mind.
t035.s2.i2: The soul is the part that lifts man above the animal level, characterized by moral choice and the urge to know God and be like him.
t035.s2.i3: Self-consciousness itself is not the soul; moral self-consciousness, as true self-realization, forms the foundation of the soul.
t035.s2.i4: The soul cannot be proved by material investigation or by purely spiritual tests, yet the morally awakened mortal knows its reality by experience.
t035.s2.i6: The morontia soul is the child both of the Father's Adjuster action and of the cosmic reaction of the Supreme Being.
t035.s3.i1: Mind is the human soil on which the Adjuster, with the co-operation of the personality, evolves the morontia soul.
t035.s3.i3: The soul can grow regardless of cultural level, but not without the decision to choose survival and to do the Father's will.
t035.s3.i4: Mistakes and errors may delay the evolution of the soul, but they cannot prevent the soul evolution that began with the consent of the will.
t035.s3.i6: The more the soul is filled with truth, beauty, and goodness, the more indestructible the resulting being becomes.
t035.s4.h: The Soul and the Human Will
t035.s4.i1: During life the deciding will resides in the material mind, but as the self grows, it becomes increasingly identified with the emerging morontia soul.
t035.s4.i3: By its own choice the mortal personality can transfer the seat of its identity from the transient material-intellect system to the morontia-soul system.
t035.s4.i5: Whether a soul is saved or lost depends on whether moral consciousness gains survival value through eternal alliance with its immortal spirit endowment.
t035.s5.i2: From death until repersonalization the soul is wholly unconscious, in the keeping of the seraphic guardian of destiny.
t035.s5.i3: In the resurrection halls the seraphim bestow the sleeping soul upon a new morontia form and unite it with the returning Adjuster.
t035.s5.i4: If a mortal does not survive, the spiritual values of his experience remain in the Adjuster, but his identity does not survive.
t035.s5.i5: The soul in the body is embryonic; it is born into the morontia life and grows through the mansion worlds.
t035.s5.i6: The immortal soul is at first morontial but rises to true spirit levels and usually fuses with the spirit of the Father who started it.
t035.s6.i1: Primitive man associated the soul with blood, breath, shadows, and reflections in water, or believed it dwelt in various organs of the body.
t035.s6.i2: Early man took the other self of dreams to be the soul, and this idea led on to belief in nature spirits.
t035.s6.i3: Hindu teachers, in the concept of the atman, almost discerned the Adjuster, but they failed to distinguish the co-evolving soul.
t036.sum: Personality is the unique gift that the Universal Father exclusively bestows upon living energy systems of matter, mind, and spirit. It is neither body, mind, spirit, nor soul; it is the one changeless reality amid ever-changing experience, and it unifies all other factors. Personality shows itself in self-consciousness and relative free will; every personality is linked to the Father by his personality circuit and survives death with the survival of the soul.
t036.s1.i1: God the Father is the bestower and conservator of every personality, and the destiny of all finite personalities who choose the divine will.
t036.s1.i3: Personality does not arise of itself; the impersonal never becomes personal without a direct act of the Father.
t036.s1.i4: Personality is not attained by degrees; it is either present or absent.
t036.s1.i5: Personality is bestowed directly by the Universal Father, or by the Conjoint Actor acting for him, and may be given to living energy systems endowed with mind or spirit.
t036.s2.i2: Human personality is neither body, mind, spirit, nor soul, and it unifies all the other factors of individuality.
t036.s2.i3: Personality is one of the unsolved mysteries of the universe; its components are known, but its real nature is not fully understood.
t036.s2.i4: Personality has no identity of its own, yet it can unify the identity of a living energy system.
t036.s2.i5: In the human system personality unifies all activities and imparts the qualities of identity and creativity.
t036.s3.i1: Personalities may be similar but never the same; even those of the same series and type are not identical.
t036.s3.i2: Because of personality we can recognize a being as the very one we knew before, however much its form or spiritual status has changed.
t036.s3.i4: Adjusters are alike in nature when they come from the Father, but personality is diverse, original, and exclusive.
t036.s3.i5: Through all the stages of evolution there is in each person a changeless part, the personality that endures amid change.
t036.s4.i1: Creature personality is distinguished by two phenomena: self-consciousness and the associated relative free will.
t036.s4.i2: Self-consciousness is awareness of one's own personality reality, and it includes the ability to recognize the reality of other personalities.
t036.s4.i3: Human free will relates to seven domains, among them moral decisions, spiritual choices, unselfish love, and worship.
t036.s4.i5: Having provided for the growth of the soul, the Father steps aside; in the matter of eternal survival he has decreed the absolute sovereignty of the mortal will.
t036.s5.i1: All personalities are circuited in the personal presence of the Universal Father, and the Father is personally conscious of every personality.
t036.s5.i2: This personality circuit exists apart from the mission of the Thought Adjusters, and personalities not indwelt by Adjusters are also embraced in it.
t036.s5.i3: Personality responds directly to the presence of other personality and is characterized by a morality that recognizes the relativity of its relations with others.
t036.s5.i5: Because we are conscious of God as Creator Father, we become conscious of men as creature brothers.
t036.s6.i1: The material self has a temporal identity and the Adjuster an eternal identity, and together they produce the surviving identity of the immortal soul.
t036.s6.i3: Human personality is eternal yet conditional as to identity; it must choose for itself whether to stand where destiny is fulfilled.
t036.s6.i4: Relationships between personalities are not scaffolding; mortal memories of personal relations have cosmic value and persist on the mansion worlds.
t036.s6.i5: The fact that God became man has forever changed all the meanings and values of human personality.
t037.sum: Mind is the gift of intelligence that originates in the Third Source and Center, the Infinite Spirit, and is bestowed upon creatures through the Seven Master Spirits and the local universe Mother Spirit. Mind deals with meanings between energy and spirit; it dominates matter while responding to the leading of spirit. In man, mind is the arena in which he makes his own decisions and chooses God or forsakes him, so the way the mind is used determines eternal survival.
t037.s1.h: The Source of Mind: The Third Source and Center
t037.s1.i1: Creature mind has its origin only in the Third Source and Center, who is the bestower of mind.
t037.s1.i2: The Conjoint Actor exerts a gravity pull upon all mind, and every true intellectual value and divine thought is drawn into the absolute mind circuit.
t037.s1.i3: The mind of man is an individualized circuit, an impersonal part, of the cosmic mind bestowed on the local universe by the Creative Daughter of the Infinite Spirit.
t037.s1.i5: Mind is absolute on Paradise, subabsolute in Havona, and finite in Orvonton, yet all levels are overspread by the mind-gravity of the Conjoint Actor.
t037.s2.h: Levels of Mind and the Cosmic Mind
t037.s2.i1: Preadjutant-spirit mind is mechanical, nonexperiencing mind, ministered by the Master Physical Controllers.
t037.s2.i2: Adjutant-spirit mind is the teachable level ministered by the Mother Spirit through the seven adjutant mind-spirits, and here mind first becomes experiencing.
t037.s2.i3: Morontia mind is the expanding consciousness of personalities in the ascending career, functioning differentially according to the 570 levels of morontia life.
t037.s2.i4: The Seven Master Spirits are the sevenfold source of cosmic mind, each distributing mind to one superuniverse, and Nebadon is pervaded by its Orvonton-type modification.
t037.s2.i5: The cosmic mind responds unerringly to three levels of reality, causation (science), duty (morality), and worship (religion), and this underlies reflective thinking.
t037.s2.i6: Energy is thing, mind is meaning, and spirit is value; mind establishes relationships between energy and spirit in time and space.
t037.s3.h: Mind at Work Between Matter and Spirit
t037.s3.i3: Mind is ever creative; the liaison of the cosmic mind and the adjutant mind-spirits fashions a body suited to evolving man.
t037.s3.i4: The universe is planned, made, and managed by mind, but lower minds cannot discern the creative spirit-mind hidden within the universe mechanism.
t037.s4.h: The Human Mind: Animal Roots and Moral Insight
t037.s4.i1: Human intellect is rooted in the material origin of the animal races, so not all phenomena of mind should be regarded as divine.
t037.s4.i3: Man defiles his mind with insincerity and unrighteousness, animal fear and needless anxiety, and so he should be humble before his immature intellect.
t037.s4.i4: Only personality knows what it is doing before it does it, and man can exercise scientific, moral, and spiritual insight in advance of experiment.
t037.s4.i5: To sharpen this inherent cosmic insight is the purpose of education, to ennoble it is the purpose of religion, and to unify it is the purpose of personality.
t037.s5.h: Mind as the Arena of Choice
t037.s5.i2: Mind is a temporary intellectual system lent for the material lifetime, and the way it is used accepts or rejects the potential of eternal existence.
t037.s5.i3: Not what the mind comprehends but what it desires to comprehend, and what it seeks to be like, brings about survival and identification with spirit.
t037.s5.i4: Mind is a cosmic instrument that, according to the will, can sound the discords of destruction or the exquisite melodies of identification with God.
t037.s5.i6: Even a personal mind has no survival qualities unless it is identified with spirit; when it lacks the capacity to worship and to crave survival, it is not immortal.
t038.sum: The seven adjutant mind-spirits are circuits of mind ministry created by the local universe Mother Spirit and named the spirits of intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, counsel, worship, and wisdom. More like circuits than independent personalities, they act on animal and human minds that can learn by experience, conditioning evolution so that it proceeds purposefully rather than by accident. When the adjutants of worship and wisdom begin to function, mind crosses the threshold of spiritual ministry and is prepared to receive the circuit of the Holy Spirit and the Thought Adjuster.
t038.s1.h: The Mind Circuits of the Mother Spirit
t038.s1.i1: The seven adjutant mind-spirits were created by the Divine Minister of the local universe; alike in character but diverse in power, they can hardly be regarded as personalities apart from their mother.
t038.s1.i2: Of the three spirit circuits of Nebadon, the third is the intelligence-ministry circuit of the seven adjutant mind-spirits.
t038.s1.i4: They are in fact a level of consciousness of the Divine Minister and are always subordinate to the action and presence of their creative mother.
t038.s1.i5: The adjutants grow in function through experience, yet they never become personal beings.
t038.s1.i6: This ministry emanates from the local universe headquarters, but the actual direction of the lower levels of mind function is centered at the system capitals.
t038.s1.i7: In the early stages of evolution the mortal races climb the grades of intelligence as they progressively make contact with the seven adjutant mind-spirits of the Mother Spirit.
t038.s2.h: The Names and Functions of the Seven Adjutants
t038.s2.i1: The spirit of intuition gives quick perception, reflex instincts, and the sense of direction, and it is the only adjutant that makes extensive contact with the mechanical levels of mind.
t038.s2.i2: The spirit of understanding is the gift of spontaneously associating and co-ordinating ideas, shown in quick reasoning and prompt decision.
t038.s2.i4: The spirit of knowledge is the mother of the curiosity that leads to adventure and discovery, and the spirit of counsel is the urge to social co-operation that brings harmony with one's fellows.
t038.s2.i7: When knowledge is elevated to new levels of meaning and activated by the presence of the adjutant of wisdom, it becomes wisdom.
t038.s3.i1: Because the presence of the adjutant mind-spirits conditions organic evolution, evolution is purposeful rather than accidental.
t038.s3.i2: The adjutants do not contact purely mechanical responses; they begin to minister the moment the capacity to learn by experience appears.
t038.s3.i3: They are not concerned with physical evolution, yet they mesh with it so perfectly that man sees in mind phenomena only the workings of nature.
t038.s3.i4: Because of Urantia's unique life pattern, the lower adjutants had greater difficulty in making contact here than almost anywhere else in Nebadon.
t038.s3.i5: Since the functioning of the first five adjutants in the animal stage is essential to human intellect, animals are indispensable to the intellectual evolution of man as well.
t038.s3.i6: The central focus at Life Carrier headquarters registers the function of the first five adjutants, but the quantitative activity of worship and wisdom is registered in the presence of the Mother Spirit on Salvington.
t038.s3.i7: The work of the Mother Spirit is done chiefly through the seven adjutants, the spirits of promise, always leading mankind toward higher thoughts and ideals.
t038.s4.i2: When mind becomes able to receive the adjutants of worship and wisdom, the mortal first experiences the ministry of spirit joined with mind.
t038.s4.i3: Creature mind before it recognizes and worships divinity is the exclusive domain of the adjutants, but as soon as spiritual response appears, it becomes supermind.
t038.s4.i4: The adjutants are not directly concerned with the highly spiritual functions of the Holy Spirit, but in evolutionary man they prepare the way ahead of the appearance of that spirit.
t038.s4.i6: All genuinely religious reactions of man are sponsored by the adjutant of worship and censored by the adjutant of wisdom.
t039.sum: The Spirit of Truth is the Creator Son's own spirit, the Comforter, which he pours out upon all flesh after completing his bestowal career. On Urantia it was poured out at Pentecost as the spirit of Michael, preparing every normal mind to receive an Adjuster. This spirit teaches truth not as law or creed but as living conviction; it creates consciousness not of itself but of Michael, and it shows forth anew the life of Jesus in the lives of believers.
t039.s1.h: The Bestowal Spirit of the Creator Son
t039.s1.i1: Of the three spirit circuits of Nebadon, the first is the bestowal spirit of the Creator Son, the Spirit of Truth, the Comforter.
t039.s1.i3: This spirit proceeds from the personality of the Son but is functionally focalized in the Divine Minister, so it works without hindrance wherever the Son may be.
t039.s1.i4: In a sense the Spirit of Truth is the spirit of both the Universal Father and the Creator Son, and it is commonly regarded as the spirit of the Universe Son.
t039.s1.i5: On Avonal bestowal worlds it comes as the joint spirit of the bestowal Avonal and the Creator Son, but after Michael's final bestowal it becomes more literally the spirit of Michael.
t039.s2.i1: Before departing, Jesus promised that, if the Father permitted, he would pour out the Spirit of Truth upon all flesh and send it as another teacher.
t039.s2.i3: Not only the one hundred and twenty in the upper chamber but every honest person in the world received this teacher according to his love of truth and his capacity for spiritual understanding.
t039.s2.i4: The bestowal of the spirit was independent of forms, ceremonies, and sacred places; prayer did not bring the spirit, but it determined the capacity of the vessel that received it.
t039.s2.i5: At that time the "baptism of the spirit" meant only the conscious reception and recognition of the gift of the Spirit of Truth.
t039.s3.h: The Work of the Spirit of Truth
t039.s3.i2: It also destroys the believer's feeling of orphanhood and helps him remember and understand the Master's words and reinterpret his life on earth.
t039.s3.i3: Living within men, the Spirit of Truth restates the message of Jesus for each new generation in terms suited to its time.
t039.s3.i4: This spirit teaches the truths of the Father's love and the Son's mercy, revealing the Father's spirit nature and the Son's moral character.
t039.s3.i6: This spirit creates no consciousness of itself, only consciousness of Michael, so its evidence is found in deepening communion with Michael.
t039.s4.i1: The Spirit of Truth is not the letter or the law of truth but the conviction of its true meaning on spirit levels, a spirit that grows and unfolds of itself.
t039.s4.i3: Without the insight of the Spirit of Truth the golden rule is only a rule of ethics; its true meaning appears when the spirit of the Son interprets the law of conduct to the spirit of the Father.
t039.s4.i4: Love must pass through ever-new interpretations, readjusting itself under the guidance of the Spirit of Truth toward the highest good of the one loved.
t039.s4.i5: The bestowed Spirit of Truth responds unerringly to truth, the living relationship in which all beings are attuned toward God.
t039.s5.h: Preparation and Guidance for the Adjuster
t039.s5.i1: Until a bestowal Son releases the Spirit of Truth, not every normal mind is automatically prepared to receive an Adjuster.
t039.s5.i2: The Spirit of Truth is poured out upon all flesh, but its function and power depend almost entirely on the degree to which a person personally receives it.
t039.s5.i3: Spiritual philosophy, the wisdom of spirit realities, is the endowment of the Spirit of Truth given by the bestowal Sons.
t039.s5.i4: Even when the ascender leaves his local universe, he is not wholly beyond the ministry of the Spirit of Truth, which points the way in every crisis of the ascent.
t040.sum: The Holy Spirit is the spirit circuit, and the personal influence, that the local universe Mother Spirit, the Divine Minister, extends throughout her universe. Proceeding from the Creative Daughter of the Paradise Infinite Spirit, it is indigenous to that local universe and bound to her personal presence on Salvington. A mind in which the adjutants of worship and wisdom function is soon encircuited in it; this is the first supermind endowment man receives and the foundation for receiving the Adjuster.
t040.s1.h: The Spirit Circuit of the Mother Spirit
t040.s1.i2: The Holy Spirit is a circuit indigenous to each local universe and confined to the spiritual realm of that creation, whereas the Infinite Spirit is everywhere present.
t040.s1.i3: In the sacred writings the term "Spirit of God" seems to refer interchangeably to the Infinite Spirit on Paradise and the Creative Spirit of the local universe.
t040.s1.i4: Of the three spirit circuits of Nebadon, the second is the spirit circuit of the Divine Minister, the Holy Spirit.
t040.s1.i5: As the spirit of the Infinite Spirit and of the Universe Mother Spirit, the Holy Spirit is often regarded as the spirit of the Universe Spirit, the "spirit of spirit" in the threefold spirit endowment.
t040.s1.i6: Mortals too can know the presence of the Infinite Spirit, for they actually experience his grace working through the Holy Spirit bestowed by the local universe.
t040.s2.i2: The Mother Spirit never leaves the universe headquarters world, and she acts as the universe focus not only of her Holy Spirit but also of the Spirit of Truth.
t040.s2.i3: The Holy Spirit and the Spirit of Truth go out from the local universe headquarters and, with the ministry of the adjutant mind-spirits, reach the lower levels of material mind.
t040.s2.i4: Because the Holy Spirit "searches all things," the Mother Spirit on Salvington knows mortals fully.
t040.s3.i2: This influence functions long before the bestowals of the divine Sons or the universal bestowal of the Adjusters, enlarging man's view of ethics, religion, and spirituality.
t040.s3.i4: This ministry to a mind that craves worship and desires wisdom creates the capacity to realize human survival both as a concept and as actual experience.
t040.s3.i5: A mind in which the adjutants of worship and wisdom function is at once included in the spiritual circuit of the Divine Minister.
t040.s3.i6: A mind ministered by the Holy Spirit has the capacity to choose the Adjuster, and the Adjuster enters only after the preparation of the adjutants and encircuitment in the Holy Spirit.
t040.s4.h: Inner Ministry and the Fruits of the Spirit
t040.s4.i1: Spiritual reason, the intelligence of the soul, is the endowment of the Holy Spirit, the gift of the Creative Spirit to man.
t040.s4.i2: The Holy Spirit works partly independently of human attitude and partly according to the co-operation of the will, sanctifying the inner life of one who fully follows its leading.
t040.s4.i5: In a life led by the spirit, the fruits of the spirit such as love, joy, and peace appear, and the kingdom of God is righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
t040.s4.i6: On worlds settled in light and life, the ministry of the Holy Spirit and the angels becomes ever more effective as the ages pass.
t040.s5.i1: Man possesses no separate part of the Creator Son or the Mother Spirit; these ministries do not indwell the mind as the Adjuster does.
t040.s5.i2: The presence in mortals of the Holy Spirit, the Spirit of Truth, and the Adjuster is a symmetry of spiritual endowment that qualifies them to realize sonship with God.
t040.s5.i4: The three supermortal endowments, the Adjuster, the Spirit of Truth, and the Holy Spirit, are unified in human experience as the ministry of the Supreme.
t040.s5.i5: The ascender uses spirit circuits such as the Holy Spirit but does not possess them, and these circuits convey to the Supreme the values emerging in the personality.
